items.title: Dick Katz interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: And we went in the studio and Percy Heath played on it.

ctx.x: And we went in the studio and Percy Heath played on it. Okay so fast forward again and here I am with Oscar Pettiford and all these, and I was not there the night, bad luck, that Cannonball came in.
